title: Armed Teen Dressed as Inmate Gets Arrested for Real on Halloween
description:
* (Disclaimer: The content in this video is intended for educational and informational purposes only)
St. Augustine, Florida — On Halloween, October 31, 2025, St. Johns County deputies responded to reports of a large disturbance involving juveniles inside the Las Calinas Subdivision. 911 callers reported a firearm was displayed. The SJSO Air Unit observed a suspicious vehicle leaving the area and navigated ground units to conduct a traffic stop. Several juveniles were contacted and a 17 year old male, dressed as an inmate, attempted to flee on foot but was quickly taken into custody. A .45 caliber handgun was discovered concealed on his person. He was charged with Resisting without Violence and Possession of a Firearm by a Minor.
